title: Mrs. Paula Margaret Olsen - Complaint Against Police

page_data.en:
R.F.M. 2
G. 48N-1-36

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.1, Special Branch. Station,
REPORT
File No. 7963
Date June 17, 37.

Subject Mrs. Paula Margaret Olsen - complaint against Police.

Made by D.S. Henchman Forwarded by [Signature]

Enquiries concerning Mrs. Olsen and the complaints
she has made against Police have made it clear that she is not
mentally balanced and that her allegations are unfounded.
Mrs. Olsen, a British subject who resides in the annexe of the
Metropole Hotel at Room 648, Hamilton House, is a widow of
over 50 years of age. She makes a living by selling ladies'
underwear and is stated to be in a comfortable financial
position. From the Hotel management it is learnt that while
always prompt in the payment of her bills, she is a continual
source of petty annoyance, frequently making unjustifiable
complaints regarding the service, food, etc. She is also
under the impression that the "boys" are in league against
her and makes preposterous claims accusing them of having
ruined her business.

（印：SPECIAL BRANCH SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE 17 JUNE 37）
（印：CLERK ROOM CIPHER 17/JUNE 37）

Mrs. Olsen is a frequent visitor to Hongkew Police
Station, where she is regarded as being slightly unbalanced,
and on a number of occasions has complained of being followed
and has requested that she be provided with a "protector".
Last year on one occasion she went to Hongkew Station and
stated that she had been assaulted by a Japanese marine; this
claim she failed to substantiate and after considerable argument
agreed to drop the case.

No one in the Special Branch is making investigations
concerning her and enquiries at the Registries fail to show
that Police are in any way interested in Mrs. Olsen.

[Signature]
copy sent to Mr. Heany.
D.C. (Special Branch). D.S.P.
FILE

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
S.1，特别股。巡捕房，
报告
档案号 7963
日期 1937年6月17日。

事由：保拉·玛格丽特·奥尔森夫人（Mrs. Paula Margaret Olsen）——针对警方的投诉。

由副督察亨奇曼（D.S. Henchman）呈报 转呈人 [签名]

经对奥尔森夫人及其对警方提出的投诉进行调查，现已查明她精神失衡，其指控毫无根据。奥尔森夫人为英国籍人士，现居住于汉密尔顿大厦（Hamilton House）大都会酒店（Metropole Hotel）附楼的648室，是一位年过五旬的寡妇。她以售卖女士内衣为生，据称经济状况宽裕。从酒店管理层获悉，虽然她总是及时支付账单，但她不断制造琐碎的麻烦，经常就服务、食物等提出无理投诉。她还认为酒店“男侍者”联合起来对付她，并荒谬地指控他们破坏了她的生意。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处特别股 1937年6月17日）
（印：文书室密码组 1937年6月17日）

奥尔森夫人是虹口巡捕房的常客，那里的人认为她精神略有失常，她曾多次投诉被人跟踪，并要求为其配备一名“保镖”。去年有一次，她前往虹口巡捕房，声称遭到一名日本海军陆战队士兵的袭击；这一说法她未能提供证据证实，经过长时间争辩后，同意撤销此案。

特别股无人正在对她进行调查，经查阅登记册也未发现警方以任何方式关注奥尔森夫人。

[签名]
副本已发送给希尼先生（Mr. Heany）。
副督察（特别股）。副总巡捕。
归档
17/6. 20/6 18/6

Date June 9, 1937.

(Crime Branch) Office Notes
Deputy Commissioner
(Crime Branch)

Mr. Heaney of the Passport and Registration Office,
H.B.M. Consulate telephoned me on the afternoon of June 3,
1937 re a complaint he had received from one Mrs. Paula
Margaret Olsen living in Hamilton House. Briefly, the
complaint was that she was being followed by a Police
officer who rode motor(?) cycle No.3I. That this officer
had, a few days prior to the 3th instant, approached her
in the C.P. Office and questioned her about her mail.
Mr. Heaney was vague as to whether it was a motor or an
ordinary cycle. He stated he was not sure whether she was
affected mentally or whether he should accept her complaint
as genuine and would, therefore, like some enquiries made.

The complainant is the widow of a Danish sea-captain,
born in Singapore, and her maiden name is Kanlcke (?).
Since her husband's death she has resumed British nationality.

Motor cycle No.3I is used by our Traffic Department
attached to Louza, but none of the officers who use this
cycle (S.I. Gazeley and Sergeants Austin and Muir) ever
heard of the woman/

I have given the P.A. (Special Branch) the particulars
as received from Mr. Heaney in case any member of the
Special Branch has an enquiry re Mrs. Olsen.

（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER 9 JUNE 1937）

M MacDermott.
Personal Assistant.

JBR 9/6

P.A.
Any information ?

日期 1937年6月9日。

（刑事股）办公室备忘录
副巡捕
（刑事股）

英国驻沪总领事馆护照与注册办公室的希尼先生（Mr. Heaney）于1937年6月3日下午致电我，提及他收到居住在汉密尔顿大厦的保拉·玛格丽特·奥尔森夫人的一起投诉。简而言之，该投诉称她被一名骑着编号为3I的摩托(?)车的警官跟踪。该警官在本月3日的前几天，曾在中央巡捕房（C.P. Office）接近她，并就其邮件情况对她进行盘问。希尼先生对于那是摩托车还是普通自行车表述含糊。他表示，不确定她是精神受影响，还是应该将她的投诉视为真实有效，因此希望进行一些调查。

投诉人系一名丹麦船长的遗孀，出生于新加坡，娘家姓为Kanlcke（?）。自丈夫去世后，她恢复了英国国籍。

编号为3I的摩托车由隶属于老闸巡捕房的交通队使用，但使用该摩托车的警官（特别巡捕盖兹利 S.I. Gazeley 以及奥斯汀 Austin 和缪尔 Muir 巡长）均未听说过这名女子。

我已将从希尼先生处获知的详情提供给特别股助理巡捕（P.A.），以防特别股任何成员有关于奥尔森夫人的查询。

（印：副巡捕 1937年6月9日）

M·麦克德莫特（M MacDermott）。
助理巡捕。

81/
JBR 9/6

助理巡捕。
有任何信息吗？
PB
